exposure.needed: whether Windows pods get launched on instance types that are not in the VPC resource controller config

consequence.statement: This is a bug fix: Windows pods on instance types missing from the VPC resource controller config no longer fail to launch. Operators do not need to do anything.

assertion.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 fixes a bug where Windows pods failed to launch when the instance type was not in the VPC resource controller config.
